description: This file defines an Android Fragment that interacts with application restrictions managed via the RestrictionsManager API. It displays restriction states, updates UI components based on restrictions, and shows a Toast message when a button is clicked.

classes.name: AppRestrictionSchemaFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages and displays app restriction settings via RestrictionsManager. It updates UI components based on current restrictions and shows a message when a button is clicked.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and sets click listeners after view creation.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resolves and applies restrictions when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: resolveRestrictions
methods.description: Fetches restrictions using RestrictionsManager and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: updateCanSayHello
methods.description: Updates UI to reflect whether the user can 'say hello', enabling or disabling the button.

methods.name: updateMessage
methods.description: Retrieves and stores the message restriction.

methods.name: updateNumber
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a numeric restriction.

methods.name: updateRank
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a string restriction for rank.

methods.name: updateApprovals
methods.description: Retrieves and displays an array of approval strings.

methods.name: updateItems
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of items if supported.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button click to display a Toast message with a restriction-based message.
